subject: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)
related_links: Linear: PM-1848 enablement plan sales/cs/support for marketplace

body:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 9:12 AM
Subject: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

Isabelle — per yesterday’s marketplace working session, can you confirm the final required HubSpot fields + forecasting rules for marketplace-sourced deals?

We’re getting inconsistent entries across AEs (AWS vs GCP, public vs private offer), and Finance asked for a cleaner reconciliation path.

Specifically need:
1) Required properties (what must be filled before moving past “Proposal/Price Quote”)
2) Forecasting guidance (when it’s in commit, what amount, and how to handle usage-based)
3) Workflow automation (deal creation, tasking, and duplicate prevention)

If you can drop the canonical checklist in email, I’ll forward it to the AE group and SE leads.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Product Lead, Dedicated SKU Fit
Redwood Inference


---

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 10:01 AM
Subject: Re: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

Yep — here’s the v1.0 checklist we’re rolling out for marketplace-sourced deals. This is written for AEs/SEs; RevOps will enforce via required fields + stage gating.

A) When to create a HubSpot Deal
- Create a Deal as soon as any of these is true:
  1) Buyer explicitly requires AWS/GCP Marketplace procurement, OR
  2) We’re initiating a private offer, OR
  3) Subscription is already live and they need onboarding/support.

B) REQUIRED HubSpot properties (Marketplace Deal Ops)
(These will be set as required before moving to “Negotiation/Review” and above.)

1) Deal Source
- "Marketplace" (new option)

2) Marketplace Provider
- AWS | GCP

3) Offer Type
- Public (self-serve) | Private Offer | Channel Private Offer (if partner-led)

4) Marketplace Product / Listing
- "Redwood Inference" (AWS) OR "Redwood Inference" (GCP)
- This is mainly to future-proof if we add add-on listings later.

5) SKU / Package (Marketplace SKU)
- Hosted API (Usage) | Dedicated (Capacity) | Private (License) | Add-on: Compliance
- If multiple SKUs: select primary + note secondary in “Deal Notes” (HubSpot limitation).

6) Billing Dimension / Meter
- Hosted: Tokens (input/output) + Embeddings (if applicable)
- Dedicated: Reserved Throughput Units (RTU) / GPU Pool Hours (final name TBD but must match marketplace dimension)
- Private: Platform License (annual) + Support Tier (if sold as a dimension)

7) Procurement Path
- “Marketplace Direct” | “Marketplace via Private Offer”

8) Marketplace Identifiers (required once available)
- Marketplace Subscription ID (AWS) / Entitlement ID (GCP) — required once buyer has subscribed
- Redwood Entitlement ID (internal) — populated by SE/CS once entitlement is verified
- Redwood Org ID — required once provisioned

9) Terms
- Contract Start Date / End Date
- Term length (months)
- Auto-renew (Y/N)

10) Financials
- Committed Spend ($) — required for Private Offer / contracts
- Expected Monthly Usage ($) — required for Public usage-based (estimate)
- Discount % (if any) + Approval Status

11) Region / Residency (if applicable)
- US | EU | APAC + “Residency requirement” (Y/N)

C) Forecasting rules (what counts in commit)

1) Public offer (usage-based)
- Forecast category: Pipeline until (a) subscription live AND (b) first invoice/usage signal exists.
- For forecasting amount: use “Expected Monthly Usage ($)” * 3 months for near-term forecast (standard), but do NOT count as committed ARR.
- Note: This is to avoid over-forecasting from procurement-only interest.

2) Private offer (committed spend)
- Forecast category: Commit only after private offer accepted in marketplace AND subscription is active.
- Forecast amount: “Committed Spend ($)” divided by term length for ARR equivalence (Finance asked for consistency).
- If buyer has signed/order form but marketplace acceptance pending: keep in Best Case.

3) Dedicated capacity SKUs
- Same as private offer rules above. Do not move to Commit until marketplace acceptance is confirmed.

4) Private deployment licensing
- Same as private offer rules; add a “Security Review Complete” checkbox in notes until we build a property.

D) Workflow automation changes (starting next week)

1) New pipeline stage (Marketplace gating)
- New stage between “Closed Won” and “Provisioned/Onboarding”: “Marketplace Subscription Confirmed”.
- Rationale: Closed Won today triggers CS handoff too early, before entitlement exists.

2) Tasks
- When “Marketplace Provider” is set, auto-create task: “Confirm subscription + collect marketplace ID(s)” (owner = AE)
- When “Offer Type = Private Offer”, auto-create task: “Request private offer approval (Finance/Legal)” (owner = AE)
- When “Marketplace Subscription Confirmed”, auto-create task: “Verify entitlement + link Redwood org” (owner = SE; CC CS)

3) Duplicate prevention
- If an existing company has an active Redwood Org ID, AEs must associate the new deal to the existing company record and use “Multi-subscription?” (Y/N) in deal notes.
- We are not blocking duplicates automatically yet (too many false positives), but we’ll report them.

I’ll paste this into the internal doc as well (link in cc) and draft the required-field rules in HubSpot today.

Isabelle Laurent
CRM & Process Owner (RevOps)
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 10:18 AM
Subject: Re: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

+1 on adding “Marketplace Subscription Confirmed” before Closed Won triggers anything.

One request: can we make Marketplace Provider + Offer Type required at deal creation? Half of my pipeline has “Marketplace” in notes but no structured data, and it’s breaking reporting.

Also for public offer usage-based: can we allow Commit once the org is provisioned + we’ve received internal entitlement verification, even if invoice hasn’t hit yet? For some of these, invoice lags and leadership wants a cleaner view.

Stephanie

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 11:02 AM
Subject: Re: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

Finance POV:

- For committed spend via private offer: we need the committed amount and term dates captured reliably. If that’s missing, our marketplace reconciliation is manual.
- For usage-based public offers: we’re OK with a “Provisioned” / “Active Entitlement” signal for internal management reporting, but please keep it out of ARR/commit until there’s at least one metered usage event or invoice confirmation. Otherwise we’ll end up reversing forecast.

Re: dimension names: please don’t hardcode “GPU Pool Hours” in required fields until Cole’s team finalizes the AWS/GCP dimension strings. But we can require the field to be non-empty and allow “TBD” for this first week.

Thanks,
Laura


---

From: Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 12:11 PM
Subject: Re: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

Good callouts.

1) Required at deal creation
- I can make these required on the deal create form for the “New Marketplace Deal” view:
  - Deal Source = Marketplace
  - Marketplace Provider
  - Offer Type
  - Procurement Path
  - SKU / Package

We won’t enforce on every deal form (to avoid breaking non-marketplace flows), but we’ll add a “Marketplace Deal” create shortcut to the AE playbook.

2) Public offer commit criteria
- We’ll split it:
  - “Forecast category (Mgmt)” can move to Commit at “Active Entitlement + Org Provisioned”
  - “Forecast category (Finance)” stays Pipeline until metered usage event / invoice signal

This keeps leadership visibility without polluting ARR.

3) Billing dimension strings
- Agreed. I’ll set the field to required but allow “TBD” until ENG-22111 closes and we have the exact AWS/GCP dimension labels. Then we’ll tighten validation.

I’ll push HubSpot changes EOD and send a short Loom + instructions to the AE channel.

Isabelle

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, Jan 23, 2026 at 2:48 PM
Subject: Re: HubSpot process update: Marketplace-sourced deals (required fields + forecasting rules)

Approved.

Isabelle — please ship the required-field gating today and send the AE-facing checklist by Monday AM.

Lauren/Stephanie/Markus — starting Monday, any marketplace deal without Provider + Offer Type + SKU gets kicked back (no exceptions). We need clean data before launch week.

Also: add a note to the checklist about multi-subscription edge cases (existing Redwood org purchasing a second marketplace SKU). We’ve already been burned once here.

Jordan Blake
CRO
Redwood Inference
